stories.agent_skills_evidence: Reusable Agent Skills procedure — Inputs: the candidate skill URL, claimed upstream repository, commit hash, manifest, scripts, requested permissions and a disposable environment with no secrets. Steps: resolve the original maintainer; compare the fork and commit; inspect install/update commands and binary downloads; run the skill only in the disposable environment; capture created files, subprocesses and network destinations; deny credentials and production repositories. Output: a signed review record listing the exact commit, differences, permissions, observed behavior and approve/quarantine decision. Validation: a second reviewer reproduces the clean run from the pinned commit, confirms no undeclared network or persistence behavior, and rejects the skill if observed files or calls differ from the manifest.
